title: Problem with selecting AAPS folder
symptom: AAPS is giving error message about not selected AAPS folder. When trying to select it from settings, the user gets: "Unable to launch activity. This is an Android issue".
cause: Family Link parental controls are blocking the activity launch in Android.
fix: The thread does not provide a specific fix, but the cause is identified as Family Link blocking the call.
